messages:
aparna: Heads up 1: upstream runtime refactor shipped last night and a few Optimize toolkit snippets are red in CI. Looks like quantitative profiles API is now `QuantConfig` and batching examples prefer `token_budget` instead of `batch_size`.

jess: On it. Can someone paste the failing CI lines?

marco: CI snippet-runner shows: `NoClassDefFoundError: com/redwood/optimize/QuantProfile` in java-snippets and `Unknown config key 'batch_size'` in the YAML lint for batching-best-practices.md. Also saw a Go example importing `github.com/redwood/optimize/quant` which no longer exists.

emily: My proposal: a single small docs PR that 1) updates all inline SDK snippets (java/py/js/go/ruby), 2) updates the YAML examples to use `token_budget` and a `batch_window_ms` field, 3) adds a short migration note at the top of optimize/quant-profiles.md, and 4) adds a grep-based CI check to catch the legacy symbols `QuantProfile` and `batch_size`. Keep it docs-only.

jess: Agree. I'll own the PR. Quick replacements I plan to push: Java snippet ->
```java
// new java snippet using QuantConfig
import com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantConfig;
QuantConfig cfg = QuantConfig.builder().preset("int8_eco").build();
```

emily: Node + Python equivalents:
```js
// node
const { QuantConfig } = require('@redwood/optimize/profiles');
const cfg = QuantConfig.fromPreset('int8_eco');
```
```py
# python
from redwood.optimize.profiles import QuantConfig
cfg = QuantConfig.from_preset('int8_eco')
```

marco: Go snippet fix:```go
// go
import "github.com/redwood/optimize/profiles"
cfg := profiles.NewQuantConfigFromPreset("int8_eco")
```

jess: And the YAML change:
```yaml
# old: batch_size: 8
batching:
  token_budget: 4096
  batch_window_ms: 12
  prefer_kv_cache: true
```

qa-bot: CI: docs-site / snippet-runner (pending) 1: running for branches/fix/opt-quant-snippets.

emily: Also found two internal links still pointing at the legacy /quant-profiles page. I'll update references and add a redirect note.

jess: Opening PR 4621 with all snippet updates, migration note, link fixes, and a grep CI job that fails on the strings: `\bQuantProfile\b` and `\bbatch_size\b`. PR description includes a quickbefore/after section.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed) 1: snippet-runner failed on one ruby example due to method rename. See logs: https://ci.redwood/4621/logs.

emily: Pushed a tiny ruby fix: change `QuantProfile.from_preset` -> `QuantConfig.from_preset`. Also standardized the example to show `token_budget` in YAML.

qa-bot: CI: docs-site / snippet-runner (running) 1: re-running on updated branch.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success) 1: all snippet tests passed.

jess: Merged PR 4621. Follow-ups: marco, can you sweep archived guides for legacy imports next sprint? matt (infra) can you add the grep check to the central docs pipeline so it runs for all PRs?

marco: Yep, I'll do an archived-docs audit and open a follow-up PR with any remaining fixes.

product: Noted for release notes: we'll add a single bullet: "Optimize: quant profile API renamed to QuantConfig; batching config key changed to token_budget. See docs/optimize/MIGRATE_QUANT.md for examples."

aparna: Thanks team 680. Small ask: add a one-line tip in the Optimize README linking to the Console dashboard for tuning token_budget vs latency. Helps customers know where to look.

jess: Done in the PR. Closing thread once infra lints are in place. :thumbsup:
